ios.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Aido uses the microphone so you can add to-dos by voice.
ios.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Aido uses Face ID to unlock the app.
ios.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Aido turns what you say into text so you can add to-dos by voice. Your voice may be processed by Apple speech recognition.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Aido needs photo library access to load images.
ios.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Aido uses your location to show the weather where you are.
